24866-a-lieutenant-at-eighteen.creator: Unknown
24866-a-lieutenant-at-eighteen.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Are you an honest man, sir?" asked a very pretty young woman, not more than twenty years old, as she stopped in the open field in front of Sergeant Life Knox of the Riverlawn Cavalry, as it was generally called, though the squadron belonged to a numbered regiment in Kentucky.

arxiv-1608-00072.title: Observation of the anisotropic Dirac cone in the band dispersion of 112-structured iron-based superconductor Ca 0.9 La 0.1 FeAs 2
arxiv-1608-00072.creator: Z. T. Liu, X. Z. Xing, M. Y. Li, W. Zhou, Y. Sun, C. C. Fan, H. F. Yang, J. S. Liu, Q. Yao, W. Li, Z. X. Shi, D. W. Shen, Z. Wang
arxiv-1608-00072.description: Abstract CaFeAs 2 is a parent compound of recently discovered 112-type iron-based superconductors. It is predicted to be a staggered intercalation compound that naturally integrates both quantum spin Hall insulating and superconducting layers and an ideal system for the realization of Majorana modes.

arxiv-2102-11562.title: Modified quantum delayed-choice experiment without quantum control
arxiv-2102-11562.creator: Qi Guo, Wen-Jie Zhang, Gang Li, Tiancai Zhang, Hong-Fu Wang, Shou Zhang
arxiv-2102-11562.description: Abstract Wheeler’s delayed-choice experiment delays the decision to observe either the wave or particle behavior of a photon until after it has entered the interferometer, and the quantum delayed-choice experiment provides the possibility of observing the wave and particle behavior simultaneously by introducing quantum control device.

arxiv-2205-02319.creator: Dylan J. Altschuler
arxiv-2205-02319.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dylan J. Altschuler. We study the critical window of the symmetric binary perceptron, or equivalently, random combinatorial discrepancy. Consider the problem of finding a ± 1 \pm 1 -valued vector σ \sigma satisfying ‖ A ​ σ ‖ ∞ ≤ K \|A\sigma\|_{\infty}\leq K , where A A is an α ​ n × n \alpha n\times n matrix with iid Gaussian entries. For fixed K K , at which constraint densities α \alpha is this constraint satisfaction problem (CSP) satisfiable?

arxiv-2412-07493.title: Ontology-driven Prompt Tuning for LLM-based Task and Motion Planning
arxiv-2412-07493.creator: Muhayy Ud Din, Jan Rosell, Waseem Akram, Isiah Zaplana, Maximo A Roa, Lakmal Seneviratne, Irfan Hussain
arxiv-2412-07493.description: Abstract Performing complex manipulation tasks in dynamic environments requires efficient Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) approaches, which combine high-level symbolic plan with low-level motion planning. Advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), such as GPT-4, are transforming task planning by offering natural language as an intuitive and flexible way to describe tasks, generate symbolic plans, and reason.

arxiv-2501-07337.title: Digital Operating Mode Classification of Real-World Amateur Radio Transmissions
arxiv-2501-07337.creator: Maximilian Bundscherer, Thomas H. Schmitt, Ilja Baumann and Tobias Bocklet
arxiv-2501-07337.description: Abstract This study presents an ML approach for classifying digital radio operating modes evaluated on real-world transmissions. We generated 98 98 different parameterized radio signals from 17 17 digital operating modes, transmitted each of them on the 70 70 cm (UHF) amateur radio band, and recorded our transmissions with two different architectures of SDR receivers.

pmc-11436079.title: Recreational Drug Overdose—Clinical Value of Toxicological Analysis
pmc-11436079.creator: Tobias Zellner, Florian Eyer, Christian Rabe, Stefanie Geith, Bettina Haberl, Sabrina Schmoll, Maria Pieri, Pascale Basilicata
pmc-11436079.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Toxicological analysis of patients with acute recreational drug poisoning can improve our understanding of substance use patterns, clinical symptoms, and improve treatment. Patient history alone may be incomplete or misleading. The objective was to assess the differences in patient history and analytical results, to describe the clinical characteristics, implications and hospital management, and to describe the drug use pattern over time.

pmc-11480117.title: Evidence for ecological tuning of anuran biofluorescent signals
pmc-11480117.creator: Courtney Whitcher, Santiago R Ron, Fernando Ayala-Varela, Andrew J Crawford, Valia Herrera-Alva, Ernesto Fernando Castillo-Urbina, Felipe Grazziotin, Randi M Bowman, Alan R Lemmon, Emily Moriarty Lemmon
pmc-11480117.description: Although biologists have described biofluorescence in a diversity of taxa, there have been few systematic efforts to document the extent of biofluorescence within a taxonomic group or investigate its general significance. Through a field survey across South America, we discover and document patterns of biofluorescence in tropical amphibians.

pmc-11610558.title: Peptostreptococcus Anaerobius enhances dextran sulfate sodium-induced colitis by promoting nf-κB-NLRP3-Dependent macrophage pyroptosis
pmc-11610558.creator: Xu-Hang Shen, Jing Guan, De-Peng Lu, Shao-Cheng Hong, Li Yu, Xi Chen
pmc-11610558.description: Evidence indicates that gut microbiota is crucial in ulcerative colitis (UC) development. Increased Peptostreptococcus species abundance is linked to UC, but its role and mechanisms in intestinal inflammation are not well understood. This study used a dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced colitis model in mice, and different bacterial strains were administered via gavage.

pmc-11639487.description: BACKGROUND:Nurses working in the emergency department increasingly face moral distress due to the nature of their profession, negatively affecting their love and compassion toward the patient. pmc-12564418.description: Ensuring the authenticity of meat products is a critical issue for consumer protection, regulatory compliance, and the integrity of local food systems. In this study, attenuated total reflectance Fourier-transform infrared (ATR-FTIR) spectroscopy combined with chemometric and machine learning models was applied to differentiate Maltese from non-Maltese pork.

pmc-12581266.title: The PAthways to Resilience And Mental health (PARAM) project: protocol for a multi-site developmental cohort in India

pmc-12581266.description: BackgroundPsychiatric disorders are increasingly conceptualised within a neurodevelopmental framework, in which genetic liability interacts with environmental exposures across the lifespan to shape brain and behavioural trajectories. Deviations in these trajectories may confer vulnerability or resilience to later psychopathology. Longitudinal cohorts spanning critical developmental windows are required to map these pathways and their associated risk and protective factors.

pmc-13099940.title: Olanzapine enhances the response of PD-(L)1 inhibitor immunotherapy: A retrospective efficacy analysis in advanced malignancies
pmc-13099940.creator: Yan-ling Yi, Meng-xue Mei, Hai-hui Wang, Jiang-zhe Ye, Zhen-jie Huang, Sha Zhao, An-wen Liu, Long Huang
pmc-13099940.description: SummaryThis retrospective cohort study explores olanzapine’s immunomodulatory role and clinical impact in patients with advanced cancer on PD-(L)1 inhibitors, given that chronic stress may impair immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) efficacy. Among 1933 patients with advanced cancer receiving PD-(L)1 inhibitors + chemotherapy (2018–2022), 99 received concurrent olanzapine for chemotherapy-induced nausea.

pmc-13120020.title: Considerations About the Antimicrobial Activity of Oxidized Cellulose and Oxidized Regenerated Cellulose and Their Potential Application in Veterinary Surgery
pmc-13120020.creator: Riccardo Rinnovati, Paola D’Angelo, Angelo Peli, Maria Virginia Ralletti, Federica Meistro
pmc-13120020.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryOxidized cellulose (OC) and oxidized regenerated cellulose (ORC) are used in veterinary surgery as topical hemostatic agents. In addition to their role in controlling bleeding, these materials may also exert antimicrobial effects through local acidification. This potential dual action is of particular interest in veterinary surgical settings, where the risk of contamination and surgical site infection remains a clinical concern.

pmc-13205569.title: Giant Cell Tumor of the Olecranon With a Displaced Pathological Fracture Successfully Treated by Intralesional Curettage and Plate Fixation: A Case Report

pmc-13205569.description: Giant cell tumor of bone (GCTB) is a locally aggressive intermediate bone tumor that typically arises at the epiphysis of long bones. GCTB occurring in the olecranon is extremely rare, and the optimal surgical strategy when complicated by pathological fractures with marked displacement involving the articular surface remains unclear. In this case, the fracture site was significantly displaced.
